tailoring.headline: SAP CX Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) & Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms including SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, and Kubernetes. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP CX Developer
cover_en.hook: As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with over 5 years of hands-on experience designing and extending enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am thrilled to apply for the SAP CX Developer position at CX Rocket. My strong background in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs aligns perfectly with your technical stack and development standards.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators and Converters.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee platforms to ensure seamless data synchronization.

bullets.label: DevOps & Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, ensuring high system stability and performance.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, enabling an earliest start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP CX expertise can drive value for CX Rocket.

tailoring.why_company: CX Rocket's focus on delivering high-impact enterprise e-commerce solutions in Baden-Württemberg makes this role an exciting opportunity for me. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, robust Java/Spring background, and proven experience in complex API integrations to help your team scale high-performance customer experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience to build scalable, high-performance enterprise CX solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. With strong expertise in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs, I am very interested in the SAP CX Developer role at CX Rocket. I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP CX Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP CX Developer position at CX Rocket. With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, and enterprise integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
